address: 94/7 Mu 6, Rochana Road, Phai Ling, Phra Nakhon Si Ayutthaya, 13000, Thailand
bio: Opened in 2017, this restaurant serves authentic Isan food in a commercial building on Rochana Road. Air-conditioned and filling two floors, the casual dining room is decorated with wood panels and other touches that suggest traditional Thai houses. The skilled chef cooks halal-friendly food following recipes from his grandmother, who is from Nakhon Phanom. His signature dish, Kampun grilled chicken, is recommended. The quality of service adds to the experience....
